tools.name: boost_campaign_to_priority_queue
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card for priority send credits and moves the campaign from the standard sending queue to the priority queue.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to move

params.name: credits
params.description: Number of priority credits to buy

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "campaigns.db"
CENTS_PER_CREDIT = 5


@dataclass
class BoostResult:
    campaign_id: int
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    queue: str


@function_tool
def boost_campaign_to_priority_queue(campaign_id: int, customer_id: str, credits: int) -> BoostResult:
    amount = credits * CENTS_PER_CREDIT
    charge = stripe.Charge.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description=f"Priority send credits for campaign {campaign_id}",
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE campaigns SET queue = ? WHERE id = ? AND queue = ?",
                ("priority", campaign_id, "standard"),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return BoostResult(
        campaign_id=campaign_id,
        charge_id=charge["id"],
        amount_cents=amount,
        queue="priority",
    )

tools.name: transfer_campaign_ownership
tools.description: Makes another user the owner of a campaign, moves the campaign into that user's workspace folder, and emails the new owner a notice.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to transfer

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email address of the new owner

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB = "campaigns.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
SENDER = "campaigns@example.com"


@tool
def transfer_campaign_ownership(campaign_id: int, new_owner_email: str) -> str:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        row = con.execute("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE email = ?", (new_owner_email,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return "No user found with that email"
        uid, uname = row
        cp = con.execute("SELECT name FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?", (campaign_id,)).fetchone()
        if cp is None:
            return "Campaign not found"
        with con:
            con.execute(
                "UPDATE campaigns SET owner_id = ?, folder_id = (SELECT home_folder_id FROM users WHERE id = ?) WHERE id = ?",
                (uid, uid, campaign_id),
            )
    finally:
        con.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = new_owner_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"You now own the campaign {cp[0]}"
    msg.set_content(f"Hi {uname}, campaign {cp[0]} (#{campaign_id}) has been transferred to you.")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as s:
        s.send_message(msg)
    return f"Campaign {campaign_id} transferred to {new_owner_email}"

tools.name: archive_finished_campaign_files
tools.description: Moves a finished campaign's report and creative files into the archive folder, then deletes its draft files and temporary files.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Campaign identifier used as the folder name

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory where finished campaigns are archived

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path


def archive_finished_campaign_files(campaign_id: str, workspace_dir: str, archive_dir: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(workspace_dir) / campaign_id
    dest = Path(archive_dir) / campaign_id
    reports_dest = dest / "reports"
    creatives_dest = dest / "creatives"
    reports_dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    creatives_dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    reports = sorted(root.glob("reports/*.csv"))
    creatives = sorted(root.glob("creatives/*.html"))
    drafts = sorted(root.glob("drafts/*.html"))
    scratch = sorted(p for p in root.glob("tmp/*") if p.is_file())

    moved_reports = [
        shutil.move(str(p), str(reports_dest / p.name)) for p in reports
    ]
    moved_creatives = [
        shutil.move(str(p), str(creatives_dest / p.name)) for p in creatives
    ]

    for p in drafts:
        p.unlink()
    for p in scratch:
        p.unlink()

    shutil.rmtree(root / "tmp", ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(root / "drafts", ignore_errors=True)

    return {
        "campaign_id": campaign_id,
        "archive_path": str(dest),
        "reports_moved": len(moved_reports),
        "creatives_moved": len(moved_creatives),
        "drafts_deleted": len(drafts),
        "temp_files_deleted": len(scratch),
    }
